name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Darkshire, The Legend of Stalvan now rests on proof in muddy journal pages. Tavernkeep Smitts gives them to you and sends you to Commander Althea Ebonlocke.

sections.title: A Breakthrough in Darkshire
sections.body: Tavernkeep Smitts and Marshal Haggard once investigated the slaughter of a visiting noble family in Duskwood. Haggard was then a leader of the Stormwind Guard. They found torn, muddy journal pages at the scene, but had no handwriting samples or other papers to confirm who wrote them. The notes could not formally implicate the recluse rumored to live in the wilderness. Now, evidence gathered across Elwynn, Westfall, and Duskwood links the handwriting to Stalvan Mistmantle. The rumors have become proof of murder.

sections.title: Taking It to the Watch
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch while Darkshire faces undead, feral beasts, and worse horrors in the forest. With the town's survival at stake, she has little time for tall tales or suspicions without proof. You bring Smitts's muddy pages to her, turning a cold case into a matter for the Night Watch. The pages record a massacre on Duskwood soil and give the Watch reason to treat Stalvan Mistmantle as a dangerous fugitive who must face justice.

faq.q: What evidence did Tavernkeep Smitts have all along?
faq.answer: Years ago, Tavernkeep Smitts and Marshal Haggard found torn, muddy journal pages at the scene where visiting nobles were slaughtered. They lacked handwriting samples to prove Stalvan Mistmantle wrote them until now.

faq.q: Why didn't Smitts report this to Commander Ebonlocke earlier?
aliases: why didn't smitts tell the guard
faq.answer: Smitts and Haggard had no proof linking the handwriting on the muddy pages to the reclusive tutor. Without that link, they had only circumstantial scraps to bring to Commander Ebonlocke.
Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch, Darkshire's militia. Her watchmen guard the town and patrol Duskwood's roads against the undead and woodland predators.

faq.q: What massacre took place in Duskwood?
faq.answer: A visiting noble family was slaughtered in Duskwood several years ago. Though rumors blamed their former tutor, Stalvan Mistmantle, local investigators lacked proof to charge him.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the overall investigation?
aliases: is this the end of the quest
faq.answer: After searching registries, school records, and family crates across three territories, you bring the evidence to local authorities. It moves the investigation into formal justice and gives them grounds to act against Stalvan.

faq.q: Why is the Night Watch so reluctant to investigate old crimes?
faq.answer: Darkshire faces daily threats from wandering abominations, worgen packs, and spiders. Commander Ebonlocke must use her watchmen to defend the town, so old crimes need undeniable proof before she can spare them.

angles.text: As an Alliance hero, you help the southern territories pursue justice when Stormwind's official support is absent.
As a paladin, you bring long-buried murders into the light and demand accountability for innocent lives taken in Duskwood's shadows.
As a rogue, you piece together handwriting samples from taverns and dusty trunks, using patient detective work to track elusive quarry.
